# FreeBIOS embeds (generated)

`freebios_images.{cpp,h}` are the FreeBIOS images the runner embeds for
the opt-in `--freebios` mode (beads-yjp.15), generated by
`tools/gen_freebios_embed.py` from the **`third_party/freebios` submodule**
(github.com/mstan/freebios — an unmodified mirror of melonDS's `freebios/`
directory: the DraStic BIOS replacement by Gilead Kutnick, BSD-2-Clause,
assembly source included).

The submodule is the single source of truth:

- images: `third_party/freebios/drastic_bios_arm{9,7}.bin`
  (SHA-1 `b85d6afd…` / `eaab9b21…`, pinned in the generator and verified
  by the runner at startup);
- recompiler configs: `tools/import_freebios_symbols.py` assembles
  `bios_common.S`, refuses unless the result is byte-identical to the
  shipped images, and emits `bios/freebios{9,7}.toml` from the source's
  own symbol table;
- banks: `nds_recompile --config bios/freebios9.toml
  --bin third_party/freebios/drastic_bios_arm9.bin --out generated
  --bank freebios_arm9` (and the arm7 equivalent).

FreeBIOS can only pair with `--boot direct` (it cannot boot the firmware
menu), and the retail-dump path remains the default and the oracle-diffed
source of truth.
